info.name: OpenAI-compatible API
info.summary: Exposes the configured Nextcloud AI providers under an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API
info.description:
Serves an OpenAI-compatible API backed by the Nextcloud Task Processing API, so third party clients that speak the OpenAI dialect can use whichever AI providers the administrator has configured for this instance.
Point the client at `https://<your-instance>/index.php/apps/openai_api/v1` and use a Nextcloud app password as the API key. Tasks are scheduled on behalf of the authenticated user and are subject to the same provider selection, task type availability and guest restrictions as any other Task Processing consumer.
info.author: Nextcloud GmbH and Nextcloud contributors
